page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Modification — definition
lines: A permanent morphological change in a plant
organ, so that it can perform a special
steps.why: Two words carry the definition: PERMANENT (not a seasonal change) and SPECIAL FUNCTION (a job different from the organ's normal one).
common_mistakes: Leaving out 'permanent' - a temporary change such as wilting is not a modification.
steps.margin_note: One clean sentence; both key words must appear.

steps.label: Banyan and mangrove
lines: Prop roots support the heavy branches;
pneumatophores grow up out of the marshy
steps.why: The question names two plants, so the answer must name two modifications - prop roots for support in banyan, pneumatophores for air in mangroves.
common_mistakes: Writing stilt roots for banyan. Stilt roots belong to maize and sugarcane.
Writing that pneumatophores absorb water. They exchange air.
steps.memory_tip: Banyan props up its branches; mangroves put up breathing pegs.
steps.margin_note: Name both modifications; the one-line functions make the answer complete.
